notes.title: Snapshot 1.3 Beta
notes.content:
I've been working on a new version of Snapshot with support for shooting time-lapse sequences.

I'd like to get some feedback before I release it, so if any current users of Snapshot are interested in beta testing the new version, then please drop me an email at support@chrishopkin.com

The time-lapse feature is the most notable change in 1.3, but I've also made some stability and minor changes, including:
[list]
    [*]Scroll bar no longer appears in the settings area
    [*]Removed annoying highlight in the settings area on Windows 10
    [*]Added support for the following cameras
[list]
    [*]Canon EOS 1D X Mk II
    [*]Canon EOS 5D Mk IV
    [*]Canon EOS 80D
    [*]Canon EOS 1200D / Rebel T5 / Kiss X70
    [*]Canon EOS 1300D / Rebel T6 / Kiss X80
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Snapshot Update Released
notes.content:
Snapshot now supports complete control of your camera's settings - the value of each setting can now be changed via drop-down boxes.

This update also adds a 'Shoot' button to remotely fire the Shutter Release.

More updates to follow, please get in touch with any feedback or suggestions.
